answer: Random mutual audit stops a sybil farm by sending each identity's work to strangers, not friends. Each epoch, three random auditors re-run the task and sign it; two failures freeze the identity. A zephyr of random draws blocks pre-arranged reviewers, and the k-th fake still needs its own 40-credit deposit: 1,000 fakes lock 40,000 credits. The named failure mode, audit-ring collusion, is caught when a summit panel of five re-checks a sample; colluders lose deposits, while an honest agent pays one deposit, keeps its full share, and leaves a karst-like trail of checks.
